stem: A wooden sign is shaped like the figure shown, in which each pair of adjacent sides is perpendicular. All lengths are in inches. What is the area of the sign, in square inches?
solution: Split the sign into a top rectangle and a bottom rectangle.

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is the area of the top rectangle only; the bottom part of the sign is left out.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is the perimeter of the sign, the distance around it, not its area.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is \(36 + 4 \cdot 4\); it takes the bottom part as \(7 - 3 = 4\) inches tall, but the 7 already measures only the bottom part.

verify:
choices = {o: choices[n] for o, n in {'A': 'A', 'B': 'B', 'D': 'C', 'C': 'D'}.items()}; answer = {'A': 'A', 'B': 'B', 'C': 'D', 'D': 'C'}[answer]  # shuffled: original letters
P=figure['points']
o=['A','B','C','D','E','F','G','H']
ans=Rational(1,2)*abs(sum(P[o[i]][0]*P[o[(i+1)%8]][1]-P[o[(i+1)%8]][0]*P[o[i]][1] for i in range(8)))
assert P['B'][0]-P['A'][0]==12 and P['B'][1]-P['C'][1]==3 and P['E'][0]-P['F'][0]==4 and P['D'][1]-P['E'][1]==7
assert ans==12*3+4*7==64
assert value(choices[answer])==ans
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
per=sum(abs(P[o[i]][0]-P[o[(i+1)%8]][0])+abs(P[o[i]][1]-P[o[(i+1)%8]][1]) for i in range(8))
assert value(choices['B'])==per
